name: Maboroshi no Dystopia
source:
In the far future, the world’s population had grown to an unsustainable amount. The country descended into chaos and the government built a special protection area with high walls as the final paradise: Utopia. Ryouta comes from a noble family and was promised a life in peace, but he hides a certain ambition in his heart. It is a secret which cannot be told to anyone.

A certain tragic event in Ryouta’s past caused his life to ‘end’ and that something happened in his previous school prior to his transfer. Utopia is not quite the paradise that is envisioned, with different castes occupying different areas of the city. The lowest tiers in this city of over 200,000 are about to fall into ‘dystopia’.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/07/12/july-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在遥远的未来，世界人口增长到了不可持续的程度。国家陷入混乱，政府建立了一个特殊的保护区，高墙作为最后的天堂：乌托邦。良太出身于贵族家庭，被许诺过上平静的生活，但他内心却隐藏着一定的野心。这是一个不能告诉任何人的秘密。

亮太过去的某件悲惨事件导致他的生命“结束”，而他转学前的学校也发生了一些事情。乌托邦并不完全是想象中的天堂，不同的种姓占据着城市的不同区域。这座超过20万人口的城市的最底层即将陷入“反乌托邦”。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/07/12/july-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
